questions.q: What did Rat tell Toad to do as soon as he pulled him out of the river?
choices: Go upstairs, wash, and put on some of Rat's clothes
Go straight home to Toad Hall and lock the doors
Sit down and tell him all of his adventures at once
Hide down in the cellar in case the police came
questions.evidence: put on some of my clothes

questions.q: How did Rat react as Toad boasted about his adventures over lunch?
choices: He grew more grave and silent
He laughed and cheered him on
He fell fast asleep in his chair
He begged to hear them all again
questions.evidence: the more grave and silent the Rat became

questions.q: What does the chapter say was a comforting point in Toad's character?
choices: He was good-hearted and took scolding from real friends well
He never once told a lie, even when a lie would have helped him
He was always modest and quiet about his own deeds
He never got angry, however badly he was treated
questions.evidence: never minded being jawed by those who were his real friends

questions.q: Toad said he would lead a quiet life, "pottering about my property." What does "pottering" mean here?
choices: Doing small, easy jobs at a relaxed pace
Making clay pots and jugs to sell
Racing around the grounds at top speed
Selling off things he no longer needs

questions.q: What terrible news did Rat give Toad?
choices: The Stoats and Weasels had taken over Toad Hall
The Badger had moved far away from the Wild Wood
Toad Hall had burned down to the ground one night
The police were waiting for him at Toad Hall
questions.evidence: how they've been and taken Toad Hall

questions.q: Why had Mole and Badger been living at Toad Hall when it was attacked?
choices: To keep it aired and ready for Toad's return
Because their own homes had been flooded out
Because Toad had sold it to them before prison
To hide there from the weasels and the stoats
questions.evidence: have it all ready for you when you turned up

questions.q: What happened when Toad first marched to his front gate with a stick?
choices: A ferret with a gun fired a shot over his head
The weasels opened the gate and let him in
He beat the sentries and fought his way inside
The Badger stopped him at the gate and sent him back
questions.evidence: a bullet whistled over his head

questions.q: What happened when Toad tried to reach Toad Hall by boat?
choices: Stoats dropped a stone from a bridge and sank the boat
The boat hit a rock in the weir and broke apart
He reached the boat-house safely and hid there
The ferrets chased him in their own fast boat
questions.evidence: A great stone, dropped from above, smashed through the bottom of the boat.

questions.q: Why was Rat so cross after Toad's boat trip?
choices: Toad lost Rat's boat and ruined the suit Rat lent him
Toad had eaten all of the supper Rat was saving for Mole
Toad had told the weasels exactly where Rat lived
Toad had broken Rat's best window with a stone
questions.evidence: Lost me my boat that I was so fond of

questions.q: Toad sobs that he will go out into the cold to find his friends, then stops when he hears supper arriving. What does this show about him?
choices: His feelings change fast, and his comfort comes first
He is the bravest and most loyal friend of all the animals
He did not hear what the Rat had just said to him
He is afraid of going out into the cold and dark
questions.evidence: Surely I heard the chink of dishes on a tray!

questions.q: What had Mole and Badger been doing while Toad was away?
choices: Camping out in all weather, watching over Toad Hall
Living snug and comfortable in the Badger's house
Travelling far and wide to find Toad in prison
Fishing on the river every day with the Otter
questions.evidence: camping out in the open, in every sort of weather

questions.q: How did the arguing animals finally fall silent?
choices: Badger told them all to be quiet
Toad started to cry very loudly
There was a sudden knock at the door
Rat banged a pan on the table
questions.evidence: Be quiet at once, all of you!

questions.q: What great secret did Badger reveal?
choices: A secret tunnel runs from the river-bank into Toad Hall
Badger had secretly owned half of Toad Hall all along
The weasels were planning to leave Toad Hall soon
Toad's father had hidden a treasure in the cellars

questions.q: Why had Toad's father told Badger not to tell Toad about the passage?
choices: Toad could not keep a secret
Toad was afraid of dark tunnels
The passage was too dangerous to use
Toad would sell it to someone

questions.q: How did Badger learn about the Chief Weasel's banquet?
choices: Otter dressed as a sweep and called at the back-door
Mole hid in a hedge and overheard the sentries talking
A weasel boasted about it to Toad by the river
Rat read all about it in the local newspaper
questions.evidence: I got Otter to disguise himself as a sweep

questions.q: The stoats "make the best sentinels in the world." What is a sentinel?
choices: A guard who keeps watch
A cook who makes the meals
A messenger who runs errands
A singer at a banquet
questions.evidence: they make the best sentinels in the world

questions.q: What did Mole do the next morning while Toad was still asleep?
choices: Dressed up as the washerwoman and scared the sentries
Went fishing with the Otter at the weir before breakfast
Sharpened all the swords and cleaned the pistols for the fight
Explored the secret passage alone with a lantern
questions.evidence: I've been getting a rise out of the stoats!

questions.q: How did Toad feel when Badger praised Mole as clever?
choices: Wildly jealous
Proud of his friend
Bored and sleepy
Frightened
questions.evidence: The Toad was simply wild with jealousy

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Toad learns his home was seized, and friends plan to win it back
Toad escapes from prison and rides home on a canal barge
Rat dreams of travelling South with the Sea Rat
Mole and Rat find Portly on the island at dawn
questions.evidence: There are more ways of getting back a place than taking it by storm.
